title: Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Ltd — Shareholders meeting
text: Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of Annual General Meeting held on August 31, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
